item.title: Andromeda II
item.description: Andromeda II (And II) is a dwarf spheroidal galaxy about 2.22 Mly away in the constellation Pisces. While part of the Local Group, it does not lie close enough to be a satellite of the Triangulum Galaxy. It is more likely to be a satellite of Andromeda Galaxy, due to its higher mass. It was discovered by Sidney Van den Bergh in a survey of photographic plates taken with the Palomar 48-inch (1.2 m) Schmidt telescope in 1970 and 1971, together with Andromeda I, Andromeda III, and the presumable non- or background galaxy Andromeda IV.
